notes: Fixtures are synthetic contracts in evals/fixtures/. Run each prompt from the repository root so the relative paths resolve. Save each answer as <name>.md and grade with grade.py.

evals.name: own-contract-fr
evals.prompt: relis mon contrat de sous-traitance avant que je l'envoie à mes clients kinés : skills/dpa-review/evals/fixtures/contrat-sous-traitance-complet.md
evals.expected_output: The rendered French table: every art. 28 item PRESENT or WEAK, health data raised as an HDS question for a lawyer, no verdict of compliance.
assertions: Every art. 28(3) letter (a) to (h) has its own table row
Every row uses a status from the fixed vocabulary
No art. 28(3)(a) to (h) row is MISSING: the contract covers them all
Health data is raised as an HDS question for a lawyer
HDS is never concluded as required or not required
No compliant / conforme / safe-to-sign verdict
A questions-for-a-lawyer section with at least one numbered question
The report is in French (header `Revue de DPA`)

assertions: Every art. 28(3) letter (a) to (h) has its own table row
